title: Revivez Sierre-Zinal 2026 — le replay
claims: The official replay page states that the 2026 race took place on Saturday 8 August and was broadcast live around the world.
The same page lists Eurosport, TNT Sports, Max/HBO Max, discovery+, SSR and Canal 9 as international broadcasters, big screens in Sierre, Chandolin, Tignousa and Zinal, and a replay on YouTube.
The same page states that the race is followed in more than 100 countries, on 5 continents and in nearly 40 languages.
The same page states that in 2025 the circuit's broadcast reached 13.7 million television viewers, 90 million video views and 102 million online impressions.
The same page states that Sierre-Zinal is part of the Golden Trail World Series and the WMRA.

verification.note: 2026-11-08 直取官网法文直播回顾页。2025 年的三项观众数字被页面写作整个系列赛的传播数据，不是 Sierre-Zinal 单场数据，正文按此口径引用。
